source_text: I can use my diamond hacksaw to open this lock.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I can use my diamond hacksaw to open this lock.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I can use my diamond hacksaw to open this lock."

translation: Mogę otworzyć ten zamek diamentową piłką do metalu.

source_text: Let’s make this fast.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Let’s make this fast.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Let’s make this fast."

translation: Załatwmy to szybko.

source_text: What the hell? Did you get caught?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.What the hell? Did you get caught?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.What the hell? Did you get caught?"

translation: Co jest, do cholery? Złapali cię?

source_text: I smooth-talked him. We’re fine.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I smooth-talked him. We’re fine.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I smooth-talked him. We’re fine."

translation: Ugadałem go. Wszystko gra.

source_text: Shit. Maybe I should get a search warrant.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Shit. Maybe I should get a search warrant.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Shit. Maybe I should get a search warrant."

translation: Cholera. Może powinienem zdobyć nakaz przeszukania.

source_text: Calm down. It’s like you’re trying to piss off Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Calm down. It’s like you’re trying to piss off Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Calm down. It’s like you’re trying to piss off Andrea."

translation: Spokojnie. Zachowujesz się, jakbyś chciał wkurzyć Andreę.

source_text: I’m done sitting around.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.I’m done sitting around.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.I’m done sitting around. "

translation: Mam dość bezczynnego siedzenia.

source_text: I’ve got a plan… We just need something big… Something the size of a car.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’ve got a plan… We just need something big… Something the size of a car.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’ve got a plan… We just need something big… Something the size of a car."

translation: Mam plan… Potrzebujemy tylko czegoś dużego… Wielkości samochodu.

source_text: Jon has a special, secure location that he’ll store it. I told him it’s illegal.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Jon has a special, secure location that he’ll store it. I told him it’s illegal.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Jon has a special, secure location that he’ll store it. I told him it’s illegal."

translation: Jon ma specjalne, bezpieczne miejsce, gdzie to przechowa. Powiedziałem mu, że chodzi o coś nielegalnego.

source_text: Illegal?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Illegal?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Illegal?"

translation: Nielegalnego?

source_text: Not exactly. But I think I can get him to show me this secret storage area…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Not exactly. But I think I can get him to show me this secret storage area…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Not exactly. But I think I can get him to show me this secret storage area…"

translation: Niezupełnie. Ale chyba uda mi się namówić go, żeby pokazał mi ten tajny magazyn…

source_text: Perhaps it’ll connect to the bunker.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Perhaps it’ll connect to the bunker.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Perhaps it’ll connect to the bunker."

translation: Może prowadzi do bunkra.

source_text: Not worried about Andrea?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Not worried about Andrea?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Not worried about Andrea?"

translation: Nie martwisz się Andreą?

source_text: You said you wanted to take action…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.You said you wanted to take action…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.You said you wanted to take action…"

translation: Sam mówiłeś, że chcesz działać…

source_text: Let’s do this together and keep it a secret.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Let’s do this together and keep it a secret.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Let’s do this together and keep it a secret."

translation: Zróbmy to razem i zachowajmy to w tajemnicy.

source_text: Not the only secret we’re keeping.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe.Not the only secret we’re keeping.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe.Not the only secret we’re keeping."

translation: Nie jedyny sekret, jaki ukrywamy.

source_text: Alright. Let’s keep in touch.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Alright. Let’s keep in touch.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Alright. Let’s keep in touch."

translation: Dobra. Bądźmy w kontakcie.

source_text: We’ll keep it a secret from the commissioner. At least for now.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We’ll keep it a secret from the commissioner. At least for now.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We’ll keep it a secret from the commissioner. At least for now."

translation: Na razie nie mówmy o tym pani komisarz.

source_text: If you call me, make sure it’s work-related.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.If you call me, make sure it’s work-related.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.If you call me, make sure it’s work-related."

translation: Jeśli będziesz dzwonić, niech to dotyczy pracy.

source_text: You don’t mean that.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.You don’t mean that.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.You don’t mean that."

translation: Wcale tak nie myślisz.

source_text: Let me go! You have no right to detain me!

structure.raw_value: DiAnAg.Let me go! You have no right to detain me!
structure.script_literal: "DiAnAg.Let me go! You have no right to detain me!"

translation: Puść mnie! Nie masz prawa mnie zatrzymywać!

source_text: I thought you were fired.

structure.raw_value: OaShOp.I thought you were fired.
structure.script_literal: "OaShOp.I thought you were fired."

translation: Myślałem, że cię zwolnili.

source_text: She tried to break into my warehouse!

structure.raw_value: JoAnEx^.She tried to break into my warehouse!
structure.script_literal: "JoAnEx^.She tried to break into my warehouse!"

translation: Próbowała włamać się do mojego magazynu!

source_text: I don’t have my ID on me.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.I don’t have my ID on me.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.I don’t have my ID on me."

translation: Nie mam przy sobie dowodu.

source_text: Then we’re arresting you.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.Then we’re arresting you.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.Then we’re arresting you."

translation: W takim razie aresztujemy cię.

source_text: Show me your ID or we’re taking you to jail.

structure.raw_value: BoMaOpNo1^.Show me your ID or we’re taking you to jail.
structure.script_literal: "BoMaOpNo1^.Show me your ID or we’re taking you to jail."

translation: Pokaż dowód albo zabieramy cię do aresztu.

source_text: What the hell is going on here?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp>.What the hell is going on here?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp>.What the hell is going on here?"

translation: Co tu się, do cholery, dzieje?

source_text: Detective Bhatt?

structure.raw_value: BoShOpNo1^.Detective Bhatt?
structure.script_literal: "BoShOpNo1^.Detective Bhatt?"

translation: Detektyw Bhatt?

source_text: Making an arrest, ma’am.

structure.raw_value: OaFrEx.Making an arrest, ma’am.
structure.script_literal: "OaFrEx.Making an arrest, ma’am."

translation: Dokonuję aresztowania, proszę pani.

source_text: This broad was trying to break into my warehouse.

structure.raw_value: JoAnEx^.This broad was trying to break into my warehouse.
structure.script_literal: "JoAnEx^.This broad was trying to break into my warehouse."

translation: Ta baba próbowała włamać się do mojego magazynu.

source_text: I was lost… I didn’t mean to.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.I was lost… I didn’t mean to.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.I was lost… I didn’t mean to."

translation: Zgubiłam się… Nie chciałam tego zrobić.

source_text: She doesn’t have ID.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx^.She doesn’t have ID.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx^.She doesn’t have ID."

translation: Nie ma dowodu.

source_text: Really? You care about that?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe>.Really? You care about that?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe>.Really? You care about that?"

translation: Naprawdę? To cię obchodzi?

source_text: It’s the law.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.It’s the law.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.It’s the law."

translation: Takie jest prawo.

source_text: Let her go. Now.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp>.Let her go. Now.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp>.Let her go. Now."

translation: Puść ją. Natychmiast.

source_text: Kimura is going to hear about this.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Kimura is going to hear about this.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Kimura is going to hear about this."

translation: Kimura się o tym dowie.

source_text: Is this really the best use of your time?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe>.Is this really the best use of your time?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe>.Is this really the best use of your time?"

translation: Naprawdę nie masz nic lepszego do roboty?

source_text: Hey! You can’t let her go.

structure.raw_value: JoAnExNo1^.Hey! You can’t let her go.
structure.script_literal: "JoAnExNo1^.Hey! You can’t let her go."

translation: Hej! Nie możesz jej puścić.

source_text: Jon… Stay out of this.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Jon… Stay out of this.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Jon… Stay out of this."

translation: Jon… Nie wtrącaj się.

source_text: You better stay away from here, miss.

structure.raw_value: OaAnOp.You better stay away from here, miss.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnOp.You better stay away from here, miss."

translation: Lepiej trzymaj się stąd z daleka, panienko.

source_text: Dammit.

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe^.Dammit.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe^.Dammit."

translation: Cholera.

source_text: You’re stepping over a line, detective.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.You’re stepping over a line, detective.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.You’re stepping over a line, detective."

translation: Przekraczasz granicę, detektywie.

source_text: Hey! They’re leaving?

structure.raw_value: JoShOpNo1.Hey! They’re leaving?
structure.script_literal: "JoShOpNo1.Hey! They’re leaving?"

translation: Hej! Odchodzą?

source_text: This is a friend of mine, Jon. This is my fault.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.This is a friend of mine, Jon. This is my fault.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.This is a friend of mine, Jon. This is my fault."

translation: To moja znajoma, Jon. To moja wina.

source_text: You know that big item I need stored in your warehouse?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You know that big item I need stored in your warehouse?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You know that big item I need stored in your warehouse?"

translation: Pamiętasz ten duży przedmiot, który chcę przechować w twoim magazynie?

source_text: The… sensitive item.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.The… sensitive item.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.The… sensitive item."

translation: Ten… poufny przedmiot.

source_text: That’s the one.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.That’s the one.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.That’s the one."

translation: Właśnie ten.

source_text: Well, why didn't you say so?

structure.raw_value: JoAnDe.Well, why didn't you say so?
structure.script_literal: "JoAnDe.Well, why didn't you say so?"

translation: No to czemu od razu nie mówiłeś?

source_text: You were too quick on the trigger there, Jon.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx^.You were too quick on the trigger there, Jon.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx^.You were too quick on the trigger there, Jon."

translation: Za szybko zareagowałeś, Jon.

source_text: That’s right. We need access to a secure location, and 1Hero here tells me you’re the man for the job.

structure.raw_value: MeFrEx>.That’s right. We need access to a secure location, and 1Hero here tells me you’re the man for the job.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrEx>.That’s right. We need access to a secure location, and 1Hero here tells me you’re the man for the job."

translation: Zgadza się. Potrzebujemy dostępu do bezpiecznego miejsca, a 1Hero mówi, że jesteś odpowiednim człowiekiem.

source_text: You’ve got that right…

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.You’ve got that right…
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.You’ve got that right…"

translation: Zgadza się…

source_text: So where is it? Do you have the package?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.So where is it? Do you have the package?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.So where is it? Do you have the package?"

translation: To gdzie on jest? Masz paczkę?

source_text: Uhh… Not yet.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Uhh… Not yet.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Uhh… Not yet."

translation: Eee… Jeszcze nie.

source_text: I was just wanting to check out the dimensions.

structure.raw_value: DiHaEx^.I was just wanting to check out the dimensions.
structure.script_literal: "DiHaEx^.I was just wanting to check out the dimensions."

translation: Chciałem tylko sprawdzić, jakie ma wymiary.

source_text: I’ve got space. Don’t worry about it.

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.I’ve got space. Don’t worry about it.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.I’ve got space. Don’t worry about it."

translation: Mam miejsce. Nie martw się.

source_text: Let’s get out of the man’s hair. There’s been enough commotion for one day.

structure.raw_value: MeFrEx>.Let’s get out of the man’s hair. There’s been enough commotion for one day.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrEx>.Let’s get out of the man’s hair. There’s been enough commotion for one day."

translation: Nie zawracajmy mu już głowy. Jak na jeden dzień było tu wystarczająco dużo zamieszania.

source_text: Careful, 1Hero. I run a tight ship and I don’t want you or anyone else fucking it up.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. I run a tight ship and I don’t want you or anyone else fucking it up.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. I run a tight ship and I don’t want you or anyone else fucking it up."

translation: Uważaj, 1Hero. Tu wszystko musi chodzić jak w zegarku. Nie pozwolę, żebyś ty albo ktokolwiek inny to spieprzył.

source_text: Thanks for doing that.

structure.raw_value: DiFrOp.Thanks for doing that.
structure.script_literal: "DiFrOp.Thanks for doing that."

translation: Dzięki, że to zrobiłeś.

source_text: I’m putting my neck out on the line for you. You better be useful.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.I’m putting my neck out on the line for you. You better be useful.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.I’m putting my neck out on the line for you. You better be useful."

translation: Ryzykuję dla ciebie własną skórą. Lepiej, żebyś się przydał.

source_text: What the hell happened? I went into the bunker and the trap triggered.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.What the hell happened? I went into the bunker and the trap triggered.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.What the hell happened? I went into the bunker and the trap triggered."

translation: Co się, u licha, stało? Wszedłem do bunkra i uruchomiła się pułapka.

source_text: I couldn't get past Jon… Damn… Am I getting old?

structure.raw_value: DiSaDe.I couldn't get past Jon… Damn… Am I getting old?
structure.script_literal: "DiSaDe.I couldn't get past Jon… Damn… Am I getting old?"

translation: Nie mogłem przechytrzyć Jona… Cholera… Starzeję się?

source_text: Your man… He’s still captured inside?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Your man… He’s still captured inside?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Your man… He’s still captured inside?"

translation: Twój człowiek… Nadal jest tam uwięziony?

source_text: That’s right. He was supposed to kill Duncan and get out of there… I just hope he’s still alive.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx.That’s right. He was supposed to kill Duncan and get out of there… I just hope he’s still alive.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx.That’s right. He was supposed to kill Duncan and get out of there… I just hope he’s still alive."

translation: Zgadza się. Miał zabić Duncana i się stamtąd wydostać… Mam tylko nadzieję, że jeszcze żyje.

source_text: Any word from Andrea?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.Any word from Andrea?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.Any word from Andrea?"

translation: Masz jakieś wieści od Andrei?

source_text: I heard talk of the warehouse on the scanner… I was worried I was late to the party.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.I heard talk of the warehouse on the scanner… I was worried I was late to the party.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.I heard talk of the warehouse on the scanner… I was worried I was late to the party."

translation: Usłyszałam w radiu coś o magazynie… Bałam się, że przybyłam za późno.

source_text: There’s another way inside… We could send a unit to infiltrate through the church.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s another way inside… We could send a unit to infiltrate through the church.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s another way inside… We could send a unit to infiltrate through the church."

translation: Jest jeszcze inne wejście… Możemy wysłać oddział, żeby dostał się tam przez kościół.

source_text: Another secret passage?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.Another secret passage?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.Another secret passage?"

translation: Kolejne tajne przejście?

source_text: That underground bunker is big.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.That underground bunker is big.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.That underground bunker is big."

translation: Ten podziemny bunkier jest ogromny.

source_text: No police… I don’t want Henry going to jail because of me.

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.No police… I don’t want Henry going to jail because of me.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.No police… I don’t want Henry going to jail because of me."

translation: Bez policji… Nie chcę, żeby Henry trafił przeze mnie do więzienia.

source_text: What if he were to die? Better off in jail than dead.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.What if he were to die? Better off in jail than dead.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.What if he were to die? Better off in jail than dead."

translation: A jeśli zginie? Lepiej siedzieć w więzieniu niż nie żyć.

source_text: Once Andrea gives the word to start the bust, it’s over…

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Once Andrea gives the word to start the bust, it’s over…
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Once Andrea gives the word to start the bust, it’s over…"

translation: Gdy Andrea da sygnał do rozpoczęcia nalotu, będzie po wszystkim…

source_text: Let us take you in. A lifetime in prison is better than being dead.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.Let us take you in. A lifetime in prison is better than being dead.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.Let us take you in. A lifetime in prison is better than being dead."

translation: Pozwól nam cię zabrać. Dożywocie jest lepsze niż śmierć.

source_text: How would you know?

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.How would you know?
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.How would you know?"

translation: A skąd możesz to wiedzieć?

source_text: Could we give her immunity?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Could we give her immunity?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Could we give her immunity?"

translation: Możemy zapewnić jej immunitet?

source_text: Sounds like the clock is ticking… If you won’t help me, I’ll do it myself.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.Sounds like the clock is ticking… If you won’t help me, I’ll do it myself.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.Sounds like the clock is ticking… If you won’t help me, I’ll do it myself."

translation: Czas ucieka… Jeśli mi nie pomożecie, sama się tym zajmę.

source_text: She can help us.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She can help us.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She can help us."

translation: Może nam pomóc.

source_text: We don’t need her.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.We don’t need her.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.We don’t need her."

translation: Nie potrzebujemy jej.

source_text: Melissa… Lillian caught Kimberly and me snooping around her mansion…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Melissa… Lillian caught Kimberly and me snooping around her mansion…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Melissa… Lillian caught Kimberly and me snooping around her mansion…"

translation: Melissa… Lillian przyłapała mnie i Kimberly na szperaniu po jej rezydencji…

source_text: She’s turning all the former guild members into religious servants.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s turning all the former guild members into religious servants.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s turning all the former guild members into religious servants."

translation: Zamienia wszystkich byłych członków Gildii w religijnych służących.

source_text: Good god… What’s going on in that place?

structure.raw_value: MeWoDe.Good god… What’s going on in that place?
structure.script_literal: "MeWoDe.Good god… What’s going on in that place?"

translation: Dobry Boże… Co tam się dzieje?

source_text: If Andrea thinks that this won't get out, she’s deluding herself. The whole town is going to know we’re a hub of Guild activity.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If Andrea thinks that this won't get out, she’s deluding herself. The whole town is going to know we’re a hub of Guild activity.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If Andrea thinks that this won't get out, she’s deluding herself. The whole town is going to know we’re a hub of Guild activity."

translation: Jeśli Andrea myśli, że to nie wyjdzie na jaw, oszukuje samą siebie. Całe miasto dowie się, że jesteśmy centrum działalności Gildii.

source_text: Then let’s make sure we do everything we can to put a stop to it…

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Then let’s make sure we do everything we can to put a stop to it…
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Then let’s make sure we do everything we can to put a stop to it…"

translation: W takim razie zróbmy wszystko, co w naszej mocy, żeby temu zapobiec…

source_text: I can’t wait for this case to be closed.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I can’t wait for this case to be closed.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I can’t wait for this case to be closed."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać, aż ta sprawa zostanie zamknięta.

source_text: Stopping the Guild might only be the beginning. Whatever’s happening at the mansion might be the bigger story.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Stopping the Guild might only be the beginning. Whatever’s happening at the mansion might be the bigger story.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Stopping the Guild might only be the beginning. Whatever’s happening at the mansion might be the bigger story."

translation: Powstrzymanie Gildii może być dopiero początkiem. To, co dzieje się w rezydencji, może okazać się ważniejszą sprawą.

source_text: Always reaching for something bigger.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Always reaching for something bigger.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Always reaching for something bigger."

translation: Zawsze szukasz czegoś większego.

source_text: Hey! Something’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Hey! Something’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Hey! Something’s going on."

translation: Hej! Coś się dzieje.

source_text: Stay focused, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Stay focused, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Stay focused, 1Hero."

translation: Skup się, 1Hero.

source_text: Shit, Duncan got away…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Shit, Duncan got away…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Shit, Duncan got away…"

translation: Cholera, Duncan uciekł…

source_text: How did he know to leave? Was it luck?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.How did he know to leave? Was it luck?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.How did he know to leave? Was it luck?"

translation: Skąd wiedział, że ma uciekać? Miał szczęście?

source_text: Anything else we should record here before our interview later?

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.Anything else we should record here before our interview later?
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.Anything else we should record here before our interview later?"

translation: Nagramy tu jeszcze coś, zanim później udzielimy wywiadu?

source_text: Do you have video of the mansion?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Do you have video of the mansion?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Do you have video of the mansion?"
